static_traits.name: Liu Han
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with boss; Good family support; other social situations Not mentioned
static_traits.medical_history: No prior history of similar problems; no prior psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; emotionally negative, skeptical; somewhat resistant in counseling but basically cooperative, tending to filter positive information and negate its value

basic_info.main_problem: Despite long Work hours and good income, feeling trapped as a Restaurant manager in a Work with no future; this feeling has lasted about a year and appears almost daily While at work.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because the feeling of being trapped in the current job brings significant distress and affects overall well-being.

core_beliefs: If my efforts are not recognized by my boss, it means I have no value

special_situations.event: Working over 60 hours per week yet feeling the boss has not yet recognized my efforts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only when the boss explicitly recognizes or promotes me does my effort count as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working harder through overtime to earn recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one sees my efforts; this Work is destined to have no future

special_situations.event: Frequently thinking While at work that the current position lacks career growth opportunities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot see a clear promotion path, this Work equals a dead end
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly attends to job restrictions and repeatedly ponders their negative aspects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am trapped; continuing is utterly Meaningless

special_situations.event: Trying to find other Work opportunities but not yet succeeding
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a few job applications do not go well, it means I will struggle to get out later too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces time for relaxation and being with family; mood is even lower
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never find a better way out

special_situations.event: Praised by regular customers for running the restaurant smoothly at peak times
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Sporadic positive feedback does not mean my Work is valuable or has a future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating the importance of positive events, not recording or paying attention to them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just coincidence, of no help to my future

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen, to gain career growth and self-actualization
core_conflict.fear: Fearing efforts will be ignored and negated, worrying about long-term career stagnation, life losing meaning
defense_goal: Easing the Anxiety of being ignored through overtime and seeking external recognition
Maintains a negative interpretation of work to lower expectations and avoid being disappointed again

object_relations.self_representation: A neglected striver / a trapped practitioner
object_relations.object_representation: A boss who does not recognize me and blocks growth, an authority figure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests focusing on the positive side or doing a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these approaches are merely comforting, unable to change the 'dead-end' reality
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a doubting and negating tone, emphasizing 'it is useless' and 'it will not change anything', picking out insufficiencies in each suggestion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the boss not yet giving feedback or promotion
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing feelings of being ignored and worthless to the boss's bias or non-recognition
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing the other's faults, in a tone of dissatisfaction and accusation, reducing exploration of my own controllable factors.

manifestations: Repeatedly feels work is a 'dead end', lacking achievement and satisfaction
Feeling frustrated and resentful about the boss's non-recognition
Difficulty relaxing and enjoying time with family
outcomes: Relationship tension with boss, Overall happiness lowered

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Blaming my helplessness and value doubts on the boss's 'non-recognition'
When talking about career being blocked, emphasizes others' problems and pays less attention to controllable aspects

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: When invited to focus on positive events, quickly emphasizing 'this is useless, it will not change the facts' to avoid directly experiencing positive feelings
Not lingering on or engaging with rare positive feedback (like customer praise)

exception_events.target_problem: At work, often focuses attention on the negative and stagnation, believing everything is a 'dead end', and thus feels frustrated and trapped.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one busy period, a regular customer praised how smoothly he ran the restaurant at peak hours, letting him experience recognition and competence in the moment (unlike the usual total negativity).
exception_events.reason: Different support: direct positive feedback from customers; different situation: peak hours better showcase his organizing and coordinating abilities, thus forming visible positive evidence.

positive_force: Family support, can provide help when encountering difficulties
Strong work engagement and execution (long working hours each week)
Actively looks for other job opportunities, has motivation to change
Occasionally receives positive feedback from customers, showing competence and influence
negative_force: Excessively relying on external recognition (supervisor evaluations) to define self-worth
Mental filtering and negating the positive, difficulty integrating positive evidence
Generalizing short-term job-hunting setbacks into long-term hopelessness, forming a 'dead-end' narrative
Persistent frustration and resentment lower performance and further solidify the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: The negative automatic thought 'this job is a dead end' repeatedly appears at work, accompanied by strong frustration and resentment toward her supervisor
antecedent: Thinking at work about the lack of career growth opportunities
The boss has not yet given recognition or promotion feedback
Job-hunting attempts have not yet made progress
Fatigue and stress from long-term high-intensity work
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigid Interpretation and negative cognitions about career stagnation (mental filtering, negating the positive), using external recognition as the value benchmark
target_behavior.function: Self-protection (avoiding further disappointment by negating the positive), maintaining a sense of control over the situation
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, Relationship tension with boss, Difficulty relaxing with family, overall distress and Increased stress

target_behavior.behavior: Over-Working (60+ hours per week) in hopes of Gaining recognition and a sense of control
antecedent: Feeling efforts are not yet seen, value threatened
Believes only harder effort can prove oneself worthy of recognition
target_behavior.core_reason: An external-recognition-driven conditional assumption (must be recognized by the boss to count as valuable)
target_behavior.function: Seeking boss's recognition and potential promotion opportunities; avoiding directly facing the helplessness of 'stagnation'
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental stress accumulates, leisure and family time are compressed, negative emotions intensify and further affect performance
